measure: The production pipeline over the corpus: the real AnalysisRegistry built from RegistrySettings.production with Stages.production(), one analysis.start per run on a fresh data directory (COLD), events captured in process. Per stage, durationMs, status and counters come from analysis.stage.completed and are cross-checked equal to the analysis_stage rows; analysisWallMillis is analysis.started to the terminal event by arrival time; bindMillis is the runner's own log line; firstTickMillis is registry.start returning to the first analysis.progress frame (the in-process analogue of the first-progress line of scripts/verify-analysis.sh, without the pipe or a fresh JVM); heap from HeapPeakMeter over the whole run; cacheBytes is the closed file. Elements, dependencies and metric rows are SQL over the run's rows, against benchmarks/code-metrics.json. Each selection runs one gap-census analysis first (an injected copy of SOURCE_ANALYSIS wiring the same production classes, a timestamp-only BooleanSupplier in front of the token), then the three timed runs.

settings.firstTick: registry.start returning -> the first analysis.progress frame reaching the sink, in process: the analogue of what scripts/verify-analysis.sh measures over the real pipe
settings.gapCensus: One extra analysis per selection, outside the medians: the production StagePlan with SOURCE_ANALYSIS replaced by a copy that wires the same production classes (ElementWriter with the cancellation supplier, StructureExtractor, SourceProgressVisitor, SpoonModelBuilder.analyze) and puts a timestamp-only BooleanSupplier in front of the stage's token. Every interval between two consecutive checks is counted; stack samples of the analysis thread, the first 100 ms into an open interval and then one every 250 ms, name its class (majority of samples); the tail, last check -> analyze returning, competes as an interval. prologueWalk is the same supplier through RepositoryValidator.inspect and the first-parent root walk, once per repository, outside the registry.
